stories.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
stories.simple_summary: A company called Trajectory just raised 45 million dollars to help people who are not computer experts train AI models, which is like teaching AI to do tasks. This is mostly important to investors and tech companies rather than everyday people.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and technology companies. There's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI, is warning that AI might soon be able to teach itself how to get better without much human help. Some people worry this could lead to AI becoming very powerful very quickly in ways we cannot control.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to people who study AI and think about its future. For now, it does not change anything in your daily life or business.

stories.title: Palm Beach plane crash footage isn’t AI-generated, despite social media claims
stories.simple_summary: After a plane crash in Palm Beach, some people on social media claimed the video was made by AI. This is not true, according to fact checkers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a good reminder to be careful about claims on social media and check facts before you believe or share them.

stories.title: SEC’s AI Disclosure Scrutiny Meets Growing Unease Over Infrastructure Financing
stories.simple_summary: The government agency that watches over money and investments is looking closely at whether companies are being honest about how they use AI. There are also questions about who pays for the powerful computers that AI needs.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies and investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Zocdoc opens infrastructure to AI agents, launches partnership with Instinct
stories.simple_summary: Zocdoc, a website that helps people find doctors and make appointments, is now letting AI assistants work with their system. They partnered with a company called Instinct to make this happen.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Zocdoc to book doctor appointments, AI might start helping with that process in ways that could make it easier or faster.

stories.title: The 3 Best Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks to Buy in November
stories.simple_summary: A financial advice website picked three AI company stocks that they think might be good investments to buy this month.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people managing retirement accounts. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
stories.simple_summary: Squarespace, a popular company that helps small businesses build websites, just let go of 19 percent of its workers as part of reorganizing its business. The company did not explain the exact reasons why.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Squarespace to run your website, this could mean changes to the service you receive, but there's no immediate action you need to take.

stories.title: WSCC HumanKind series to explore impact of artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: A college series called HumanKind is planning to explore how artificial intelligence is changing society and people's lives.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're interested in learning about AI, this educational series might be worth watching to understand what AI does and how it affects communities.

stories.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
stories.simple_summary: The New York Times and other news outlets are suing a web browser called Brave for taking their news articles and sharing them without permission. Brave gave this content to AI companies like Anthropic.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about who owns words and pictures on the internet and whether companies can use them without asking. It's a legal fight between big companies, though it could shape how AI gets trained in the future.

stories.title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic made rules for its Claude AI tool so people cannot use it to copy old video games. They want to stop people from making AI versions of games that already exist.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to game developers and programmers. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Johns Hopkins cancer cell mapping technology chosen for Anthropic AI project
stories.simple_summary: Johns Hopkins University created technology for mapping cancer cells, and now it's being used in a project with Anthropic, an AI company.
stories.why_it_matters: This could help doctors and medical researchers understand cancer better by using AI, which might lead to better cancer treatments someday.

stories.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI says it will run a program in Georgia where its data centers will give power back to the local area during emergencies or extreme heat. This could power air conditioners in about 700,000 homes when needed.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live near where OpenAI builds its computer centers, this program might help keep the local power grid stable during hot weather or emergencies.
